item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "8731b79ee5c1e2592fc843e7fedbd9d71a25279ef407bfe388e832b823efed5e",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef002 specialized to the coordinate type Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side of the equivalence unfolds to the same existential derivative condition as the right side.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For a finite coordinate type ι, asserts the existence of vectors qt and fluxx such that τ ↦ q x τ has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ flux(q ξ t) has derivative fluxx at x, and qt + fluxx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the entire left-hand predicate; it includes derivative existence and cancellation at the selected point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For every index type ι, real scalar multiplication on ι → Real is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication needed to formulate the vector-valued derivative predicates; adds no assumption on q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real additive structure for scalar actions without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction, requiring both propositions to hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the two derivative statements and the zero-sum equation simultaneously.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of multiplication gives joint continuity of the corresponding self scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuous real scalar multiplication on each real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and derives nontriviality of the norm from the densely normed field property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Real the nontrivially normed scalar field used by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative action underlying a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the real module action through the action hierarchy without changing scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semiring of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar semiring structure on Real used in the vector module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The equation is equality of vectors, hence qt(i) + fluxx(i) = 0 for every i in Fin m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Binds qt and then fluxx as vectors in Fin m → Real for each fixed m, q, flux, x, and t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Constructs the underlying semifield using the field's existing arithmetic operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real scalar arithmetic; it imposes no positivity restriction on scalars.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the type of natural-number indices i with 0 ≤ i < m.",
      "effect_on_target": "There are m real coordinates, indexed from 0 through m − 1; for m = 0 there are no coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Selects the addition operation supplied by a heterogeneous addition structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here it selects ordinary pointwise addition of two vectors of the same type.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that f has derivative vector f' at x, using HasDerivAtFilter with the product of the neighborhood filter of x and the pure filter at x. In the real finite-dimensional setting this is the ordinary derivative: the difference quotient tends to f'.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires actual two-sided derivatives of the time slice and the spatial flux composition at the specified real points.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, asserting implication in both directions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies the local predicate exactly with the displayed existence-and-cancellation condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring supplies the corresponding topological semiring property for its inherited operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Helps obtain continuity of real multiplication; adds no regularity requirement on q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts joint continuity of multiplication from a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of real multiplication for the scalar-action continuity instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action underlying a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the existing real module action on coordinates without changing its meaning.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts associative multiplication from a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar semigroup structure in the action hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative monoid acting on coordinates; zero remains an allowed scalar.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action while supplying a weaker required structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension m is arbitrary and may equal zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and commutative multiplication while forgetting the requirement of multiplicative associativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an inherited real ring structure for topological instances without altering arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity from the supplied nonunital, potentially nonassociative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the structural input for real topological ring instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, multiplication, and distributive laws while forgetting additive inverses.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker real algebraic structure for continuity of multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid of a nonunital, potentially nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and zero for module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital commutative ring operations while forgetting normed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real algebraic operations in the topology-instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity of multiplication while retaining the nonunital seminormed ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the structure from which the real seminormed additive group is extracted.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric from a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real seminormed additive structure used by the normed-space-to-module projection.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets the associativity requirement while retaining the operations of a nonunital semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Helps extract the real additive commutative monoid for the vector module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and field operations used in differentiation and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, metric, addition, and multiplication while forgetting the distinguished multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real nonunital normed ring structure used in the continuity-instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations, norm, and induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real topology and arithmetic when supplying weaker analytic structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real field arithmetic for scalar modules and actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed commutative ring structure of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real ring and metric structures used to obtain the scalar topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Makes a normed field a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by field multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes each coordinate's real scalar action as ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the vector-space/module structure from a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real module used to build the coordinate-vector module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal using the supplied OfNat instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed 0 as a vector, specifically the zero function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Builds the pointwise module structure on functions I → β from the module structure on β.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin m → Real a real vector space with coordinatewise scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Builds the pointwise additive commutative group on a family of functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives vectors coordinatewise addition, subtraction, and negation for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Defines function addition by (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The cancellation equation sums the derivative vectors coordinate by coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "Defines the zero function by assigning zero to each coordinate.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side of qt + fluxx = 0 is the zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Defines the product topology using the topologies induced by all coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector derivatives use the usual finite product topology on real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transfers the real metric structure toward the topology used in derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both independent variables, all coordinates, and all scalars are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Equips Real with its normed field structure and the property that positive norm values occur between any two strictly ordered positive bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar-field instance required for ordinary real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Supplies real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each coordinate of qt + fluxx is an ordinary sum of real numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Supplies the additive commutative group structure on Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the pointwise additive group used for vector-valued derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Supplies real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coordinate scalar action is real multiplication, whose continuity is used.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "Supplies the ring structure on Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real additive and semiring structures for the module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "Supplies the real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each coordinate of the zero vector is real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Combines the real normed additive group and commutative ring into a compatible normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real arithmetic, norm, and topology used by the derivative infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "Combines the real normed additive group and field into a normed field with multiplicative norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the real normed scalar field and its self vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Defines real distance by dist(x,y) = |x − y|, with its associated metric uniformity.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coordinate topology is the ordinary topology of the real line.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semiring of a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real semiring operations in module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains semiring operations, inverses, and division while forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the existing real arithmetic through the scalar structure hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same real scalar multiplication used for coordinatewise action continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains norm, pseudometric, addition, and multiplication while forgetting the distinguished multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real structure from which the seminormed additive group is obtained.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring structure, forgetting multiplicative commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and pseudometric in the scalar-topology construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric space structure from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar pseudometric underlying the real topology for continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts multiplication, identity, zero, and their monoid-with-zero laws from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative structure used in scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital semiring structure while retaining the existing addition and multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Helps obtain the real additive commutative monoid required for modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual real topology from the metric uniformity for scalar and coordinate spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 using the supplied zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the numeral in the vector equation denotes the pointwise zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Jointly continuous scalar actions on each coordinate induce a jointly continuous pointwise scalar action on the product.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuous real scalar multiplication on Fin m → Real for HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary addition operation as heterogeneous addition with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed vector sum to the pointwise addition instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The real numbers with their usual topology and ring operations form a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of real multiplication, hence of scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all elements of Fin n using finRange n, without duplicates and exhaustively.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the finite-index instance needed to specialize LocalDef002 to Fin m, including m = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A structure giving a finite exhaustive enumeration of a type's elements.",
      "effect_on_target": "The general local predicate requires a finite coordinate type; the target satisfies this automatically through Fin m and does not require nonemptiness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of the map (a,v) ↦ a • v for the specified scalar action and topologies.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural prerequisite of the derivative predicates, automatically supplied here; it does not assert continuity of q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Pi.instSMul",
      "meaning": "Defines scalar multiplication of functions pointwise by (a • f)(i) = a • f(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector scalar multiplication is (a • v)(i) = a v(i), as used in vector derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m, including zero.",
      "For every function q : Real → Real → (Fin m → Real), viewed as a vector-valued function q(x,t) on the entire real plane.",
      "For every function flux : (Fin m → Real) → (Fin m → Real), mapping a state vector to a flux vector.",
      "For every pair of real numbers x and t.",
      "On the right side, there exists qt in Fin m → Real and then there exists fluxx in Fin m → Real. These witnesses are chosen for the fixed m, q, flux, x, and t; the inner witness is within the scope of qt."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [],
    "conclusions": [
      "LocalDef001 q flux x t holds if and only if there exist vectors qt and fluxx such that all three conditions hold: τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at τ = t; ξ ↦ flux(q(ξ,t)) has derivative fluxx at ξ = x; and qt + fluxx is the zero vector.",
      "Equivalently, the derivatives ∂t q(x,t) and ∂x[flux(q(x,t))] both exist and their sum is zero in Real^m. The equation means qt(i) + fluxx(i) = 0 for every index i with 0 ≤ i < m.",
      "Because LocalDef001 abbreviates LocalDef002 and LocalDef002 is defined by exactly this existential condition, the equivalence is an unfolding of the predicate's definition."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "Real^m is represented by functions Fin m → Real, with pointwise vector operations and the finite product of the usual real topologies.",
      "The time derivative witness qt satisfies lim as h → 0, h ≠ 0, of (q(x,t+h) − q(x,t))/h = qt.",
      "The spatial flux derivative witness fluxx satisfies lim as h → 0, h ≠ 0, of (flux(q(x+h,t)) − flux(q(x,t)))/h = fluxx.",
      "Division by h in these vector limits means multiplication of every coordinate by the real scalar 1/h.",
      "LocalDef002 is the existence of these two derivative vectors together with their zero-sum equation for an arbitrary finite coordinate type; LocalDef001 specializes that definition to Fin m."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For every nonnegative integer m, every vector-valued function q on the real plane, every state-to-flux function flux on Real^m, and every real point (x,t), the predicate LocalDef001 q flux x t holds exactly when the time derivative of q with x fixed and the spatial derivative of the composed flux with t fixed both exist at that point and add to the zero vector. The predicate on the left is defined to mean precisely the condition on the right."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The dimension is finite but need not be positive. For m = 0 the vector space has a single element, both slice maps are constant, their derivatives are the unique zero vector, and the predicate holds automatically.",
    "Both independent variables range over all real numbers. There is no restriction to nonnegative time, a bounded spatial interval, or any other designated domain.",
    "The derivatives are ordinary two-sided derivatives at the specified points, not derivatives within a restricted set or one-sided boundary derivatives.",
    "No differentiability assumptions precede the equivalence. Derivative existence is part of the condition being characterized; the theorem does not assert that arbitrary q and flux satisfy that condition.",
    "The equivalence is universally quantified over points, but it does not assert that the local predicate is true at every point for a given q and flux.",
    "Only two slice derivatives are required. Joint differentiability of q, continuity of its derivatives, and existence of the spatial derivative of q itself are not required.",
    "The derivative of ξ ↦ flux(q(ξ,t)) is required directly. Differentiability or continuity of flux as a function on its entire state space, and a Jacobian or chain-rule representation of that derivative, are not encoded.",
    "The two existential witnesses are vectors at the chosen point, not globally chosen derivative fields. No separate existence or uniqueness theorem for solutions is asserted.",
    "No initial conditions, boundary conditions, integral conservation identity, weak or distributional formulation, entropy condition, or additional physical interpretation is encoded.",
    "The statement is a definitional equivalence and supplies no independent criterion guaranteeing that either side holds."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
